label: H-01
resolution: Folded into C-01 as open hardening note. Owner-gated, funds flow to owner (by-design migration pattern); accounting desync is a latent footgun only under partial-emergency-then-continue. Not a standalone High in the self-owned trust model.
title: emergencyWithdraw transfers vault shares to owner without updating clientBalances or totalDeposited, permanently corrupting the accounting ledger and making the strategy insolvent
description: _emergencyWithdraw calls IERC20(address(vault)).safeTransfer(owner(), sharesToTransfer) without touching clientBalances[token][*] or totalDeposited[token]. The physical backing is removed but the principal ledger retains its pre-withdrawal values, making the strategy provably insolvent.
impact: After emergencyWithdraw: (1) every subsequent client withdrawal receives less underlying than their credited principal; (2) _accrueSurplusShares finds totalValue < totalDeposited for all clients and returns zero surplus — yield collection is permanently bricked; (3) _totalWithdraw proportional calculations use stale totalDeposited as denominator, assigning inflated share fractions to remaining clients who then receive nothing because the shares are already gone.
attackPath: 1. Owner (or compromised owner key) calls emergencyWithdraw(amount) on ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy
2. _emergencyWithdraw transfers sharesToTransfer vault shares to owner() via safeTransfer
3. No update to clientBalances[token][*] or totalDeposited[token]
4. Every subsequent client withdrawal calculates a proportional share fraction against the now-stale totalDeposited — but the shares no longer exist
5. Clients receive zero or less underlying than credited; _accrueSurplusShares always sees totalValue < totalDeposited and returns zero
6. Medusa counterexample: 2-step sequence yields heldValue deficit of 130e21 wei

medusaFailure.counterexample: depositForClient(seed, amount) then emergencyWithdrawPartial(amount): heldValue=285969984088074546357438, totalDeposited=416102355444464034513528, deficit=130132371356389488156090 wei

halmosFailure.counterexample: totalDeposited=0x8000000000000000, emergencySharesRemoved=0x800000000000000; totalValueAfter < totalDeposited, solvency invariant violated

forgeDirect.result: PASS — after 1000e18 deposit and full emergencyWithdraw, strategy holds 0 shares, principalOf returns 1000e18, heldValue (0) < totalDeposited (1000e18)
